headline: Leverage flushed, market stalls: funding down to 3.52%, volume just 44% of its 20-day average, price hovering above the true market mean.
summary: Leverage did not rebuild after the long flush: weighted funding fell from 6.48% to 3.52%, volume was only 0.44x its 20-day average, and the close sat just 0.78% above the true market mean of $79,430. Short-term holders are not capitulating, yet ETFs and the Coinbase premium show no spot buying either, so both sides are waiting. Bull day 17, no exit rule triggered; watch the FOMC at 02:00 Taipei Oct 29 (18:00 UTC Oct 28) and the Oct 30 monthly expiry.

points: 46 straight closes above a rising 200-day MA ($72,945; $70,930 thirty days ago); bull stage since 2026-10-09.

findings.title: Leverage flushed, volume dried up: both sides wait above the true market mean
findings.lean_why: Less liquidation fuel and no capitulation are positives, but ETFs, the Coinbase premium and stablecoins show no new buying, so the forces cancel out.
findings.what: Oct 25 weighted funding 3.52% (prior 6.48%), Hyperliquid down from 10.95% to 1.04%; volume 0.44x the 20-day average and 0.47x the prior day; the $80,048 close is +0.78% above the true market mean of $79,430 (bitcoin-data, Oct 19), the fourth day of this price-level signal.
findings.why: Decomposing derivatives: the cooling came from Hyperliquid, the largest open interest ($3.40B), while OKX actually rose from 2.40% to 7.64% and Deribit sits at 1.85%; perp funding is 3.64 pp below the 5.49% median futures basis, so leveraged longs are colder than futures. Sellers did not show up in size: short-term holder realized losses 1,618 BTC (CheckOnChain, Oct 25), STH-SOPR 1.0037 still above 1, CoinMetrics daily net realized P&L +$29.8M (Oct 24). Buyers are missing too: Coinbase premium 7-day average −0.122%, ETF Oct 23 provisional −$137.9M, stablecoin supply 7-day −0.67%. Derivatives, on-chain and spot data agree: both sides are waiting.
findings.alt: Weekend volume is low anyway, so part of the 0.44x is a day-of-week effect; Hyperliquid settles hourly and a single snapshot is noisy. The true market mean comes from bitcoin-data with a ~7-day lag, so the actual line may have moved; Glassnode's version is ~$77.6K, and different vendors are not compared.
findings.history: This price-level signal carries no historical sample (hist), so no forward statistics are available; background only. In the prior session the intraday low of $79,121 briefly broke this line before recovering.
findings.so: With less liquidation fuel, a further drop carries less cascade risk than last session; but with no spot buyers, price also lacks a driver, and direction depends on which side moves first after the events. Market stage (bull day 17) and the exit framework are unaffected.
findings.next: By Oct 30: weighted funding climbing back above 8% would mean leverage rebuilt without spot confirmation, refuting 'flushed'; a close below $79,375 is tracked under follow-up 2026-10-23-1.

items.title: Perpetual Preferred Stock: The Newest Demand Catalyst for Bitcoin
items.points: Perpetual preferred stock has funded 135,979 BTC of corporate buying since 2025-07 (as of Oct 5, over 0.5% of supply), more than 95,000 BTC in Mar–May alone with over $7B raised; it works only if BTC appreciation outpaces the cost of yield.
items.meaning: Shows treasury-company demand comes from fixed-income capital and slowed clearly after May; consistent with the absent spot buying in ETF and Coinbase premium data here; not used for the cycle read.

items.title: Fasanara Digital + Glassnode: Q4 2026 Institutional Market Perspectives
items.points: BTC reclaimed the three main on-chain cost bases after the August short squeeze, which the report treats as a healthy-bull trait; it argues the data since August is more than short covering. No current key levels given.
items.meaning: Consistent with this site's market stage (bull day 17), but the close is only +0.78% above the true market mean, so the cushion 'above cost' is now thin.
